verified: Electrek reported that Toyota is recalling about 19,000 C-HR EVs worldwide, roughly 10,000 of them in the US, and framed it as an expansion of a prior recall.
unconfirmed: the defect that triggered the recall, the fix, the notification schedule, and whether Toyota or NHTSA has formally confirmed the 19,000 and 10,000 figures — the report gives no cause, remedy, recall number, or regulator filing.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，丰田正在全球召回约1.9万辆C-HR EV，其中约1万辆在美国。
unconfirmed: 缺陷的具体原因与部位、涉及的年款和生产区间、是否已有事故或人员受伤、修复方式（软件升级还是更换零部件），以及此次是否为一次既有召回的扩大——标题称“扩大”，正文未给出原召回的任何细节；丰田自身也未在报道中给出可引用的说法。

titles.en: Toyota expands C-HR EV recall to 19,000 vehicles worldwide
titles.zh: 丰田全球召回约1.9万辆C-HR EV，美国占约1万辆
